notes.title: The release of a new chapter!
notes.content:
Major Update Now Live!

I am excited to bring you a major update, including:

[list]
[*] Added Chapter 2 with new levels.
[*] New big dragon: Stone Dragon.
[*] New enemy: Plague Doctor.
[*] Added the ability to customize lighting in the Lair.
[*] Balance improvements.
[*] Bug fixes and performance enhancements.
[/list]

tags.feature: [*] Added the ability to customize lighting in the Lair.
